description: Find and remove invisible Unicode (zero-width, bidi/Trojan Source, tag-character smuggling), fix line endings, trailing whitespace, tabs and smart quotes, and normalise Unicode. Operations: "scan" — Report invisible and special characters, hidden tag-character text, unterminated bidi controls, line endings and normalisation.; "clean" — Apply clean-ups and return the text plus counts of every change.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: scan: The text to inspect. clean: The text to clean.

operation.description: scan — Report invisible and special characters, hidden tag-character text, unterminated bidi controls, line endings and normalisation. clean — Apply clean-ups and return the text plus counts of every change.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

keepEmoji.description: Keep joiners inside emoji and non-Latin scripts. Used by: clean.

normalize.description: Unicode normalisation form. Used by: clean.

smartQuotes.description: Curly quotes → straight. Used by: clean.

tabWidth.description: Tab stop width. Used by: clean.

tabs.description: Convert tabs and spaces. Used by: clean.

trimTrailing.description: Trim trailing whitespace. Used by: clean.

name: text-cleanup
title: Text Cleanup & Invisible Characters
